name: Stromerosuchus
isnote: PBDB places it in Stromerosuchidae, which has no clade entry in the atlas yet; placed in Neosuchia, the nearest atlas ancestor.
sum: Stromerosuchus is a dubious genus of crocodyliform known from fragmentary remains from the Cenomanian Bahariya Formation of Egypt.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: Catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
material: Fragmentary remains from the Bahariya Formation.
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
author: Kuhn 1936

sources.text: Kuhn, O. 1936. Weitere Parasuchier und Labyrinthodonten aus dem Blasensandstein des mittleren Keuper von Ebrach. Palaeontographica 83: 61–98.
